string.name: body_text
string.value: The Sanjiangyuan region is located in the southern part of Qinghai Province, China, situated in the hinterland of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, with an average elevation of approximately 4,700 meters. It is home to the world's highest national park, a vast expanse of land. This region is the birthplace of the three major rivers: the Yangtze River, the Yellow River, and the Lancang River. Therefore, it is known as the "Water Tower of China" and holds an extremely important ecological position.
